speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic, I am Dr. Agent. To help me evaluate your acute diarrhea, how long have your symptoms been present and what other symptoms like fever or blood in the stool are you experiencing?

speaker: Patient
text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Antibiotic-associated colitis (likely *Clostridioides difficile* infection).

Given your recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia, severe watery diarrhea is highly concerning for a superinfection. Have you experienced any fever or bloody stools alongside your cramping?
